reviewer: recovery_release_audit subagent, independent of b23_finish implementation author
scope: Complete new cohorts orchestrator and finite plan, DI profile selection delta, observed concurrency reporting, outer failure isolation and existing A21/inner controller validity integration. No re-review or re-execution of accepted comparator/functional component matrices.

findings.problem: The outer search/matrix could start a new inner controller after that controller stopped for live or unverifiable owned-process cleanup.
findings.resolution: 9406093 propagates execution_blocker and explicit stop, marks unestablished interrupted directories blocked, records exact not-run units and rejects subsequent execution/resume. Focused no-load regression verifies the second invocation never starts.

findings.problem: The new concurrency helper assumed complete timestamps even for retained invalid A21 rows, which could fail adverse report generation.
findings.resolution: 9406093 reports unavailable/partial observations and excluded counts, only computes real complete intervals, and sorts half-window values by scheduled arrival time. Missing values are not fabricated as zero durations.

findings.problem: Individual inner runs pinned current TLS/PG/golden inputs but the cross-invocation finite selection state did not freeze them.
findings.resolution: 9406093 freezes reference golden.py, both TLS file identities, four PostgreSQL lifecycle executables, Python executable and six client module files in addition to manifests/profile/A21/controller inputs. Per-case confirmation fingerprint and artifact checks remain unchanged.

plan_assessment.search: Two predeclared offered-rate candidates for four previously adverse workload families, two fresh processes per supported route/case, no latency-based winner choice. Select largest completely valid candidate; if none passes keep lower point explicitly unvalidated. No subsequent tuning/retry loop.
plan_assessment.matrix: Every original full case receives three fresh calibration processes per supported route. Three independent confirmation processes run only for an entirely valid calibration and matching immutable inputs/noise bands. Invalid and unexecuted rows remain explicit.
plan_assessment.scope_boundaries: Original high-rate adverse records remain adverse. Cold/8MiB/overload/diagnostic profiles remain unchanged; ordinary same-native artifacts, durability, semantics and A21 statistics remain authoritative. The selection is a finite operating point, not demonstrated maximum sustainable capacity.
plan_assessment.accounting: Attempted, completed and valid calibrations/confirmations are separate; preflight failure does not imply an executed full matrix.

acceptance_boundary: Pre-measurement source/plan approval only. Actual timed cells, independent raw-data review and B22 current Linux correctness/resource closure still required. The user excluded 24h/72h; this never turns those omitted runs into passed evidence. Other platforms remain outside scope.
